meta.title: The gap by country
meta.grain: one row per country that has at least one people group on this map
meta.measured: 242 countries · 1,592 groups with nothing found · 205,861,745 people
meta.three_questions: Groups with nothing, people with nothing, and the share of the country each represents. They rank differently on purpose — Papua New Guinea has the most groups and few people, China the reverse, and Oceania has the worst share of any region while being the smallest by population.
meta.source: data/tables/gospel-by-country.json, which is itself refreshed from data/tables/people-group-pins.json — the same index the map draws, so this table and the map cannot disagree.
meta.curated_columns: growing_unreached and deaths_day come from the curated country analysis and are null where it does not cover the country. Null, never zero: zero is a claim this build cannot make.
